model.title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 201 East Grant Avenue in Georgetown, Ohio, as the "Ulysses S. Grant Post Office Building".
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee, Oversight and Government Reform Committee · Rep. David Taylor (R-OH)

summary.text: The bill would rename the U.S. Postal Service facility at 201 East Grant Avenue in Georgetown, Ohio, as the "Ulysses S. Grant Post Office Building" to honor the former president.
